subject: 英语
description: 五年级下册英语核心知识点精华总结

cards.title: 四季与月份
cards.definition: 四季、十二个月份的英语说法和相关活动。
core_points: 四季：spring春 summer夏 autumn/fall秋 winter冬
月份(1-6)：January February March April May June（首字母大写）
月份(7-12)：July August September October November December
Which season do you like best? 你最喜欢哪个季节？— I like spring. It's warm and green.

example.question: Which season do you like best?
steps: I like summer. I can swim.
example.answer: I like summer best. Because I can swim.

cards.memory_tip: 📅 月份缩写前三个字母：Jan. Feb. Mar. Apr. May Jun. Jul. Aug. Sep(t). Oct. Nov. Dec.

cards.title: 日期与生日
cards.definition: 用英语表达日期、问答生日。
core_points: 序数词：first(1st) second(2nd) third(3rd) fourth(4th)... twelfth(12th)... twentieth(20th)
When is your birthday? 你的生日是什么时候？— My birthday is in October. / It's on October 1st.
月份前用in: in January; 具体日期前用on: on January 1st
序数词规律：大多+th，特殊记1st/2nd/3rd/5th/8th/9th/12th
cards.memory_tip: 🎂 序数词特殊记: 1st 2nd 3rd (一二三特殊记), 5th(five去e), 8th(eight直接加th), 9th(nine去e), 12th(twelve去ve+fth)

units.unit_name: 日常活动与现在进行时

cards.title: 一天的活动
cards.definition: 描述一天中各个时段的日常活动。
core_points: 活动：get up起床 eat breakfast吃早餐 go to school上学 have...class上...课 eat lunch吃午餐 play sports做运动 eat dinner吃晚餐 go to bed上床睡觉
When do you get up? 你几点起床？— I usually get up at 6:30.
时间点前用at: at 7 o'clock, at noon, at night
频率词+动词: I usually/often/always/sometimes + 动词原形

example.question: When do you go to school?
example.answer: I usually go to school at 7:30.

mistakes.wrong: I get up in 6:30.（用错介词）
mistakes.correct: 具体时间点用at: I get up at 6:30.
go to school不加the（固定搭配）

cards.memory_tip: ⏰ 时间介词：at几点(小), on几号/星期(中), in月/季/年(大) → 从小到大at→on→in

cards.title: 现在进行时
cards.definition: 表示正在进行的动作，是五年级最重要的语法点之一。
core_points: 结构：主语 + am/is/are + 动词ing
加ing规则：①一般直接加ing: read→reading ②去e加ing: write→writing ③双写+ing: run→running swim→swimming
What are you doing? 你在做什么？— I'm reading a book.
关键词：now, look, listen 通常提示用进行时

example.question: Look! What is the boy doing?

cards.memory_tip: 🏃 ing加法三兄弟：①普通直加 ②哑e让座 ③重辅双写 → read-ing, writ(e)-ing, runn-ing

related.next: 见六上 一般过去时

cards.title: 动物行为与归属
cards.definition: 描述动物正在做的事和名词所有格。
core_points: 动物行为：climbing爬 jumping跳 sleeping睡 eating吃 playing玩 drinking喝 fighting打架 swinging荡
The elephant is drinking water. 大象正在喝水。
Whose monkey is that? 那是谁的猴子？— It's his/hers/theirs.
名词所有格：John's约翰的 the cat's猫的

mistakes.correct: 进行时必须有ing: The cat is sleeping.
如果后面没名词用hers: It's hers. 有名词用her: It's her monkey.

cards.memory_tip: 🐵 物主代词配对记：my→mine, your→yours, his→his, her→hers, our→ours, their→theirs
